cpi_definition: BLS CPI-U all items U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted; quarter endpoint month-average proxies
cpi_use: ex-post evaluation only; never a daily input
rf_definition: French daily one-month T-bill rate proxy, not annual quoted yield or long-bond total return
cost_model: existing 10bp traded notional, quarter entry and liquidation; RF proxy assumed frictionless
joint_wins: descriptive additional test, not approved new reward
cashflow_comparability: Each account receives identical initial lump sum or identical 1/3 monthly contributions on each first trading day; monthly investor never has future contributions early
real_gain_definition: terminal wealth / sum(contribution * CPI_end/CPI_prior_month_at_deposit) - 1; not IRR or annualized return
risks: market is equity exposure, not stable guaranteed investment
CPI endpoints are monthly averages, not exact day prices
idealized close-to-close fills and research portfolios
no taxes or additional market impact
RF proxy is not actual executable Treasury trading
